revenue_growth.source: Assumption: mature staples; FY2026 growth was 3.3% (87,032 vs 84,284), FY2025 0.3%; modest 3-3.5% volume+price, fading toward inflation-like growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 22.7% (19,748/87,032); 3-yr range 22.1%-24.3%; held slightly below FY2026 for tariff/commodity cost pressure.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate 21%; tax expense not pulled from filings, reviewer should check effective rate in 10-K.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2026 capex 4,409 / revenue 87,032 = 5.07%; rounded to 5.0% given rising investment trend (3.9%, 4.5%, 5.1%).

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.847 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = Ke 8.64%. Beta: Damodaran Household Products cash-corrected unlevered 0.741 relevered at D/E 0.18 (industry D/E, since no share price available) and 21% tax. Kd pre-tax 5.29% (Damodaran industry) -> 4.18% after tax; weights 84.6/15.4.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; consistent with staples pricing power.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = LT debt noncurrent 22,842 + current debt 11,296 - cash 9,942; no short-term investments reported; acc. 0000080424-26-000103
